newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso closes slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso closes slightly higher.

text.p: The peso showed mixed results at the close of same-day operations on Friday, due to swap operations before the weekend during quiet trade with weak volume.
"There were some swap operations, but in general the markets practically didn't move, and prices moved within a narrow range," said one dealer.
Same-day peso contracts closed slightly higher, 0.4 centavos firmer at 7.8810/7.8840 per dollar.
The benchmark 48-hour peso was unchanged at 7.8930/7.8960, while its 24-hour stablemate was 0.7 centavos weaker at 7.8900/7.8920 per dollar.
